title: Forty-Two
own_credit: Charts: Hardwood Bricks. Data: Basketball-Reference, Sports-Reference, Wikipedia, as of Nov 17, 2026

lines.speaker: TITLE
lines.visual: card:Forty-Two|Nate Thurmond, Bowling Green, and the thinnest banner in basketball

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Every school we cover gets one video before March. Its best player. Its best run. Bowling Green goes first, because Bowling Green has a Hall of Famer, and his name is Nate Thurmond.
lines.caption: Every school we cover gets one video before March. Its best player. Its best run. Bowling Green goes first, because Bowling Green has a Hall of Famer, and his name is Nate Thurmond.

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: Finally. Somebody says it out loud. Gary Mercer, Bowling Green desk. I have waited my whole fictional life for this.
lines.caption: Finally. Somebody says it out loud. Gary Mercer, Bowling Green desk. I have waited my whole fictional life for this.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: He grew up in Akron, the Rubber City. At Central High he was not even the star. He played forward behind an older kid named Gus Johnson, who also ended up in the Hall of Fame.
lines.caption: He grew up in Akron, the Rubber City. At Central High he was not even the star. He played forward behind an older kid named Gus Johnson, who also ended up in the Hall of Fame.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Ohio State wanted him. He did not want to sit behind Jerry Lucas. So he took the road west to Bowling Green, to a coach his players called Blinky.
lines.caption: Ohio State wanted him. He did not want to sit behind Jerry Lucas. So he took the road west to Bowling Green, to a coach his players called Blinky.

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: Harold Anderson. The twitch in one eye. The players named him for it. Anderson is in the Hall of Fame too. Same class as Nate, nineteen eighty-five.
lines.caption: Harold Anderson. The twitch in one eye. The players named him for it. Anderson is in the Hall of Fame too. Same class as Nate, nineteen eighty-five.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Freshmen could not play varsity back then. So his first real season was nineteen sixty. Bowling Green opened a new arena that December. Today it carries the coach's name.
lines.caption: Freshmen could not play varsity back then. So his first real season was nineteen sixty. Bowling Green opened a new arena that December. Today it carries the coach's name.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Year one, the team went ten and fourteen. Thurmond averaged seventeen points and seventeen rebounds. A losing team with a monster in the middle.
lines.caption: Year one, the team went ten and fourteen. Thurmond averaged seventeen points and seventeen rebounds. A losing team with a monster in the middle.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Year two, twenty-one and four. Mid-American champions. Ranked eighth in the country. Then Butler beat them by one point in the NCAA tournament. Fifty-six, fifty-five.
lines.caption: Year two, twenty-one and four. Mid-American champions. Ranked eighth in the country. Then Butler beat them by one point in the NCAA tournament. Fifty-six, fifty-five.

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: By one point. I still do not talk about Butler.
lines.caption: By one point. I still do not talk about Butler.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Senior year. February sixteenth, nineteen sixty-three. Number two Loyola comes to Bowling Green. Loyola will win the national championship that spring. Bowling Green beats them by seventeen.
lines.caption: Senior year. February sixteenth, nineteen sixty-three. Number two Loyola comes to Bowling Green. Loyola will win the national championship that spring. Bowling Green beats them by seventeen.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Thurmond had twenty-four and twelve. His coach called it the greatest team effort he ever saw from a Bowling Green team.
lines.caption: Thurmond had twenty-four and twelve. His coach called it the greatest team effort he ever saw from a Bowling Green team.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Another MAC title. In the NCAA tournament they beat Notre Dame. Thurmond: sixteen points, twenty rebounds. Then Illinois ended the dream in East Lansing.
lines.caption: Another MAC title. In the NCAA tournament they beat Notre Dame. Thurmond: sixteen points, twenty rebounds. Then Illinois ended the dream in East Lansing.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: And here is the part I love. His last college game was the regional consolation game, against Mississippi State. The night before, Mississippi State had sneaked out of its own state to play integrated Loyola. The Game of Change.
lines.caption: And here is the part I love. His last college game was the regional consolation game, against Mississippi State. The night before, Mississippi State had sneaked out of its own state to play integrated Loyola. The Game of Change.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Nate Thurmond, Black center from Akron, gets that team the next night. He grabs thirty-one rebounds. Thirty-one. It is still the Bowling Green record.
lines.caption: Nate Thurmond, Black center from Akron, gets that team the next night. He grabs thirty-one rebounds. Thirty-one. It is still the Bowling Green record.

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: Thirty-one rebounds. In a consolation game. That is a man rebounding against history.
lines.caption: Thirty-one rebounds. In a consolation game. That is a man rebounding against history.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Two MAC titles, an All-American season, and four hundred fifty-two rebounds as a senior, a school record. The Warriors took him third overall.
lines.caption: Two MAC titles, an All-American season, and four hundred fifty-two rebounds as a senior, a school record. The Warriors took him third overall.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: In San Francisco he backed up Wilt Chamberlain. Then the Warriors traded Wilt in nineteen sixty-five, and the middle was Nate's.
lines.caption: In San Francisco he backed up Wilt Chamberlain. Then the Warriors traded Wilt in nineteen sixty-five, and the middle was Nate's.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: He once grabbed eighteen rebounds in a single quarter. In sixty-seven, sixty-eight he averaged twenty points and twenty-two rebounds. Seven All-Star games. Some of the best defense a center ever played.
lines.caption: He once grabbed eighteen rebounds in a single quarter. In sixty-seven, sixty-eight he averaged twenty points and twenty-two rebounds. Seven All-Star games. Some of the best defense a center ever played.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Traded to Chicago in seventy-four. That October, he records the first official quadruple-double in NBA history. Twenty-two points, fourteen rebounds, thirteen assists, twelve blocks.
lines.caption: Traded to Chicago in seventy-four. That October, he records the first official quadruple-double in NBA history. Twenty-two points, fourteen rebounds, thirteen assists, twelve blocks.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Then, in nineteen seventy-five, he comes home to Ohio. The Cleveland Cavaliers. They played way out in a field in Richfield, between Cleveland and Akron.
lines.caption: Then, in nineteen seventy-five, he comes home to Ohio. The Cleveland Cavaliers. They played way out in a field in Richfield, between Cleveland and Akron.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: The Cavs were six and eleven when he arrived. They went forty-three and twenty-two after. Central Division champions. Game seven against Washington, eighty-seven to eighty-five. The Miracle of Richfield.
lines.caption: The Cavs were six and eleven when he arrived. They went forty-three and twenty-two after. Central Division champions. Game seven against Washington, eighty-seven to eighty-five. The Miracle of Richfield.

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: He came off the bench, Matthew. Started zero games that season.
lines.caption: He came off the bench, Matthew. Started zero games that season.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Zero. And they lost to Boston after Jim Chones broke his foot. Thurmond played one more year and retired in nineteen seventy-seven. That December, the Cavaliers retired number forty-two. The first number they ever retired.
lines.caption: Zero. And they lost to Boston after Jim Chones broke his foot. Thurmond played one more year and retired in nineteen seventy-seven. That December, the Cavaliers retired number forty-two. The first number they ever retired.

lines.speaker: TITLE
lines.visual: card:Part three|Now it goes off the rails

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: I love Nate Thurmond. I want that on the record. But I also have a spreadsheet.
lines.caption: I love Nate Thurmond. I want that on the record. But I also have a spreadsheet.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Here are the Cleveland rafters, drawn to scale. Every banner's length is the points that man scored for Cleveland. Ilgauskas, ten thousand six hundred. Daugherty. Carr. Price. Bingo. Nance. And forty-two. Five hundred sixty-six.
lines.caption: Here are the Cleveland rafters, drawn to scale. Every banner's length is the points that man scored for Cleveland. Ilgauskas, ten thousand six hundred. Daugherty. Carr. Price. Bingo. Nance. And forty-two. Five hundred sixty-six.

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: That is not a banner. That is a coaster.
lines.caption: That is not a banner. That is a coaster.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: A hundred and fourteen games in a Cavs uniform. The next fewest among their retired numbers is Larry Nance, four hundred thirty-three.
lines.caption: A hundred and fourteen games in a Cavs uniform. The next fewest among their retired numbers is Larry Nance, four hundred thirty-three.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Banner math. It takes nearly nineteen Cleveland Nate Thurmonds to fill one Ilgauskas banner. Eighteen point four for Daugherty. Even Larry Nance is twelve point eight Thurmonds.
lines.caption: Banner math. It takes nearly nineteen Cleveland Nate Thurmonds to fill one Ilgauskas banner. Eighteen point four for Daugherty. Even Larry Nance is twelve point eight Thurmonds.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: So is it the thinnest retired number in the league? We went through all of them. By points with the team, yes. Five sixty-six. Nobody else we found is under a thousand.
lines.caption: So is it the thinnest retired number in the league? We went through all of them. By points with the team, yes. Five sixty-six. Nobody else we found is under a thousand.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: By games, Malik Sealy in Minnesota has one fewer. And to be clear, Sealy, Bobby Phills and Dražen Petrović died while they were still playing. Those numbers are not a joke, and neither is this one. It just weighs the least.
lines.caption: By games, Malik Sealy in Minnesota has one fewer. And to be clear, Sealy, Bobby Phills and Dražen Petrović died while they were still playing. Those numbers are not a joke, and neither is this one. It just weighs the least.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Now the whole league. Two hundred forty-one retired honors across thirty franchises. The Celtics have twenty-five. The Clippers have zero.
lines.caption: Now the whole league. Two hundred forty-one retired honors across thirty franchises. The Celtics have twenty-five. The Clippers have zero.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Banners per championship. Boston hangs about one and a half per title. The Lakers, fewer than one. Phoenix has seventeen honors and no championship. Utah, eleven and none. Cleveland, nine honors, one title.
lines.caption: Banners per championship. Boston hangs about one and a half per title. The Lakers, fewer than one. Phoenix has seventeen honors and no championship. Utah, eleven and none. Cleveland, nine honors, one title.

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: Phoenix, please. Hang a trophy before you hang another jersey.
lines.caption: Phoenix, please. Hang a trophy before you hang another jersey.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: So pound for pound, forty-two in Cleveland is the lightest banner in basketball. And it was the first banner they ever hung. For the season Cleveland first believed.
lines.caption: So pound for pound, forty-two in Cleveland is the lightest banner in basketball. And it was the first banner they ever hung. For the season Cleveland first believed.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Nate Thurmond died in twenty sixteen. He was seventy-four. His number hangs in San Francisco, in Cleveland, and in Bowling Green, where he still owns the glass. Thirty-one rebounds. Keep it mid. Keep it real.
lines.caption: Nate Thurmond died in twenty sixteen. He was seventy-four. His number hangs in San Francisco, in Cleveland, and in Bowling Green, where he still owns the glass. Thirty-one rebounds. Keep it mid. Keep it real.
